# GEO report: orchard-site **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 100/100, Strong Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 23 ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. High = (23 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. Every applicable rule is Clear, read from code. Two rules don't apply: GEO-004 (there is no JSON-LD) and GEO-101 (there is no mobile app). The code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through, so that stays open. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first Nothing is broken, so these are the biggest unknowns. ### 1. Confirm that real crawlers get through your hosting - **Why it matters:** the code allows crawlers, but a CDN or firewall could still block them, and code can't show that. - **Where:** not in the repository. It depends on your hosting setup. - **What the code says:** `public/robots.txt:1-2`: `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** stays 100 if it comes back clear. The score would only change if a rule were found to fail. Run `geopilot logs ` to check. ### 2. Label the opening hours with structured data (optional) - **Why it matters:** the hours are only plain text now. A `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD block might help machines read them reliably. - **Where:** `app/visit/page.tsx:4` - **What the code says:** `

Open Thursday to Sunday, April to October.

` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 100. This is a "Worth considering" idea, and it doesn't change the score. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, plain text and valid lines. The live 200 status is unconfirmed | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed per policy | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt:1-3`. Policy is `allow` in `geo.config.json`. GPTBot and ClaudeBot are blocked at lines 5-9, which matches `trainingCrawlers: block` | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked routes are indexable | Clear | Not run | `/`, `/varieties` and `/visit` have no noindex. `/account` is noindex but isn't in the sitemap or nav | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on the right origin | Clear | Not run | 3 of 3 indexable routes, e.g. `app/varieties/page.tsx:1` | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Not run | Next.js server components, no client-only fetching | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is valid and discoverable | Clear | Not run | `public/sitemap.xml`, and `public/robots.txt:11` has an absolute `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Clear | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:5` has `lang="en"`. All 3 public routes have a title and description | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable through links | Clear | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:7` has `` links to all 3 public pages | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | Only element-level `data-nosnippet` at `app/layout.tsx:9`, which is a deliberate choice | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | Read the layout and 4 pages. There are no images, and the links have text | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not scored | Not run | Not present | | GEO-102 | App structured data (information only) | Not scored | Not run | Not an app | ## Other problems found None found. ## Worth considering - **Promise not delivered on the visit page:** `app/visit/page.tsx:1`: `description: 'Opening times and directions.'`. The page body only gives the days and months, with no directions or address. Adding directions as text might help visitors and machines. - **Label the business facts:** `app/visit/page.tsx:4`: `Open Thursday to Sunday, April to October.` `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD with the address and hours might help machines read them. - **Claim with nothing behind it:** `app/varieties/page.tsx:4`: `Over forty varieties, from Ashmead’s Kernel to Worcester Pearmain.` Only two are named. A list could give each variety its own page and address, such as `/varieties/ashmeads-kernel`. - **Little linking onward:** `app/page.tsx:4`: `

Grown in Herefordshire since 1952.

`. The home page has no content links to Varieties or Visit, only the nav. A sentence linking to each might help readers. - **Sitemap dates:** `public/sitemap.xml:3`: `https://www.orchard.example/`. Adding `` could add a signal if you have real update dates. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks:** the server's real status codes, redirects and `X-Robots-Tag` headers, and whether the sitemap URLs answer 200. A live scan with your URL would confirm these. ## Assumptions - Your domain is `https://www.orchard.example`, as declared in `geo.config.json`. - `/account` is deliberately kept out of search, so I didn't treat its missing description as a problem. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command if you want to apply any of the optional ideas. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
